base=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
native=base/'native-first'
arts={n:json.loads((native/(n+'.qirf')).read_text()) for n in ['q-random','q-false','q-reset','unit-random','unit-false']}
hist={n:obs.oracle(a['programs'][0]) for n,a in arts.items()}
zero=[F(0)]*4
def conj(z):return z[:2]+[-a for a in z[2:]]
def plus(a,b):return [x+y for x,y in zip(a,b)]
def choi(hs):
 rows=len(hs[0]['operator']);cols=len(hs[0]['operator'][0]);out={}
 for y in [False,True]:
  for o in range(rows):
   for i in range(cols):
    for p in range(rows):
     for j in range(cols):
      terms=[exact.oracle_mul(h['operator'][o][i],conj(h['operator'][p][j])) for h in hs if h['results']==[y]]
      out[(y,o,i,p,j)]=[sum((z[k] for z in terms),F(0)) for k in range(4)]
 return out
coeff={n:choi(h) for n,h in hist.items()}
def difference(a,b):return {k:[x-y for x,y in zip(v,coeff[b][k])] for k,v in coeff[a].items()}
def bound(d,epsilon):
 assert all(v[1:]==zero[1:] for v in d.values())
 qs=[abs(v[0]) for v in d.values()]
 return dict(majorants=[str(q) for q in qs],sum=str(sum(qs,F(0))),epsilon=str(epsilon),mathematical_sufficient_inequality=sum(qs,F(0))<=epsilon,nonzero=[dict(index=k,value=str(v[0])) for k,v in d.items() if v[0]])
unit=difference('unit-random','unit-false');q=difference('q-random','q-false')
assert sorted(v[0] for v in unit.values())==[F(-1,4),F(1,4)]
assert sum(abs(v[0]) for v in q.values())==2
assert len([v for v in q.values() if v[0]])==8
# Complete channel evaluation on the Bell joint input retains every coherence.
rho=[[F(1,2) if r in (0,3) and c in (0,3) else F(0) for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)]
def channel(c,y,rho,inp,res,ref):
 return [[sum((c[(y,o,i,p,j)][0]*rho[i*ref+r][j*ref+s] for i in range(inp) for j in range(inp)),F(0)) for p in range(res) for s in range(ref)] for o in range(res) for r in range(ref)]
afalse=channel(coeff['q-random'],False,rho,2,2,2);atrue=channel(coeff['q-random'],True,rho,2,2,2)
assert afalse==[[F(3,4)*z for z in row] for row in rho]
assert atrue==[[F(1,4)*z for z in row] for row in rho]
reset=channel(coeff['q-reset'],False,rho,2,2,2);ideal=channel(coeff['q-false'],False,rho,2,2,2)
assert sum(reset[i][i] for i in range(4))==sum(ideal[i][i] for i in range(4))==1
assert reset!=ideal and reset[0][3]==0 and ideal[0][3]==F(1,2)
# Exact adjoint saturation uses opposite identity observables on every outcome.
def adjoint_saturation(d,inp,res):
 return [[sum((d[(y,o,i,p,j)][0]*(1 if y else -1) for y in [False,True] for o in range(res) for p in range(res) if o==p),F(0)) for j in range(inp)] for i in range(inp)]
assert adjoint_saturation(unit,1,1)==[[F(1,2)]]
assert adjoint_saturation(q,2,2)==[[F(1,2),F(0)],[F(0),F(1,2)]]
